context: A teacher coaches a teen for a science essay competition
purpose: Teach: 方程式/レーザー/電流/波動/同氏/最良/死去/国歌

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: さくらさん、今回の懸賞論文は、物理の波動をテーマにしてみたらどうかしら。
lines.en: Sakura, how about choosing wave physics as your theme for this essay contest?
lines.style: Warm and encouraging teacher tone, gentle pacing, inviting but professional.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 波動ですか。式の立て方が難しそうで、方程式が解けるか不安です。
lines.en: Waves? The way you set up the formulas looks hard, I'm worried I can't solve the equations.
lines.style: Eager teen voice, slightly nervous, polite but honest about her doubts.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 大丈夫よ。波の話を電流の振る舞いと結びつけると、ぐっと面白くなるわ。
lines.en: It'll be fine. If you tie waves to how electric current behaves, it gets much more interesting.
lines.style: Thoughtful coaching tone, measured and intellectual, supportive guidance for an ambitious student.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なるほど。応用例として、レーザーの仕組みも少し触れていいですか?
lines.en: I see. Can I also touch a little on how lasers work as an applied example?
lines.style: Curious teen brightening up, leaning forward, sounding more confident than before.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ぜひ。レーザー研究の第一人者だった田中博士が去年死去されてね、同氏の論文は今でも最良の入門書なのよ。
lines.en: Please do. Doctor Tanaka, a leading laser researcher, passed away last year, and his papers are still the best introduction.
lines.style: Reflective and respectful, slightly somber when mentioning the death, then warming with admiration.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そうなんですね…じゃあ同氏の研究を引用しながら、丁寧に書いてみます。
lines.en: I see... then I'll write carefully, citing his research as I go.
lines.style: Sincere teen voice, softer and a little moved, settling into resolve.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いいわね。発表会では国歌斉唱のあとすぐ登壇だから、堂々と読み上げましょうね。
lines.en: Good. At the ceremony you'll go on stage right after the national anthem, so read it out with confidence.
lines.style: Warm closing tone, motherly encouragement, light practical reminder about the event.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、締め切りまで頑張ります。先生、ご指導よろしくお願いします。
lines.en: Yes, I'll do my best until the deadline. Thank you for your guidance, teacher.
lines.style: Grateful and determined teen voice, polite closing bow energy, sincere and bright.
